newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RGC says profit lower in Sept qtr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RGC says profit lower in Sept qtr.

text.p: RGC Ltd said on Wednesday its profit in the September quarter was lower than in the same period a year ago and that it would be a significant challenge to match the profit achieved in the 1995/96 financial year.
"The results for the September 1996 quarter are lower than those for the corresponding period of the first financial year," chairman Tony Cotton told shareholders at the annual meeting.
Cotton said the lower results were due to lower than expected grades at the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guina, lower ore recovery at Renison tin and increasing mining and synthetic rutile costs.
"In the light of all those factors, it will be a significant challenge for RGC to match its 1995/96 profit result," he said.
RGC, a base metals and mineral sands miner, reported a net profit of A$142.81 million in the year to June 30, 1996 from A$97.40 million in 1994/95.
RGC is about 39 percent owned by Hanson Plc.
